title: Synapse Hub Atomic Reasoning Modules (Self-Discover Pattern)
author: Thế Vị (@TeeVee98)
description: Library of 36 atomic reasoning primitives for dynamic composition of cognitive scaffolding before execution (Google DeepMind Self-Discover pattern).

modules.name: First Principles Abstraction
modules.description: Strip away implementation conventions and identify the fundamental physical, mathematical, or architectural laws governing the problem domain.

modules.name: Functional Decomposition
modules.description: Decompose complex monolithic logic into atomic, non-overlapping functional sub-problems with strictly bounded inputs and outputs.

modules.name: Temporal Sequence Mapping
modules.description: Map the exact chronological lifecycle and execution timeline of actions, identifying causal dependencies and synchronization barriers.

modules.name: State Space Enumeration
modules.description: Enumerate all valid and invalid discrete states of the system (e.g. INIT, PENDING, COMMITTED, ROLLED_BACK) and model transition invariants.

modules.name: Interface Contract Decoupling
modules.description: Separate the caller's contract expectations from the callee's internal realization, ensuring strict encapsulation and API contracts.

modules.name: Layered Responsibility Partitioning
modules.description: Enforce single responsibility per architectural tier (Presentation/POM, Business Workflow, Data Access, Infrastructure).

modules.name: Invariant Isolation
modules.description: Identify system truths that must remain strictly invariant across all mutations, queries, or failures.

modules.name: Counterfactual Simulation
modules.description: Simulate what happens if a core assumption fails or an unexpected event occurs mid-flight (e.g. 'What if the connection drops after payment but before receipt?').

modules.name: Socratic Invariance Testing
modules.description: Systematically interrogate every assumed truth: 'Why do we believe this locator will never change? What proves this assertion cannot pass vacuously?'

modules.name: Fault Injection Hypothesis
modules.description: Formulate explicit hypotheses about external faults (HTTP 500, DB lock, network latency, corrupt payload) and plan resilience defenses.

modules.name: Red-Team Boundary Stress
modules.description: Adversarially probe boundary conditions, edge cases, zero/null values, extreme payloads, and unicode glyphs.

modules.name: Malicious Payload Assumption
modules.description: Assume input vectors contain injection attacks, format-string escapes, or parameter tampering.

modules.name: Flaw Likelihood Ranking
modules.description: Rank potential failure modes by their severity and probabilistic likelihood, prioritizing critical enterprise risks over rare edge cases.

modules.name: Confirmation Bias Purge
modules.description: Strip the assumption that existing code or happy-path tests imply correctness; demand falsification evidence.

modules.name: Idempotency Invariant Check
modules.description: Verify that repeating the same operation $N$ times yields the exact same state and emits exactly 1 business mutation.

modules.name: Concurrency & Race Condition Modeling
modules.description: Model overlapping asynchronous operations, simultaneous read/write actions, and thread-safety locks.

modules.name: Asynchronous State Synchronization
modules.description: Replace static sleeps with dynamic predicate polling and event-driven state transitions.

modules.name: Resource Exhaustion Probing
modules.description: Evaluate system behavior under memory pressure, socket exhaustion, database pool starvation, and file handle leaks.

modules.name: Backpressure & Rate Cliff Analysis
modules.description: Analyze performance degradation cliffs when request arrival rate exceeds consumer processing capacity.

modules.name: Reentrancy Guarding
modules.description: Ensure methods cannot be recursively entered before prior invocations have cleanly finished state commits.

modules.name: Transaction Boundary Integrity
modules.description: Define atomic transaction scopes where all operations either commit simultaneously or roll back cleanly without leaving orphan data.

modules.name: AST Grounded Tracing
modules.description: Anchor all reasoning in concrete Abstract Syntax Tree declarations, function calls, imports, and dataflow paths.

modules.name: DOM/AOM Accessibility Mapping
modules.description: Derive resilient element locators from semantic Accessibility Object Model trees (role, accessible name, state) instead of fragile DOM paths.

modules.name: Network Contract Verification
modules.description: Ground expectations against formal OpenAPI schemas, request/response headers, status codes, and JSON schemas.

modules.name: Database Entity Lifecycle Tracking
modules.description: Track the persistent database state of entities from creation through mutations to automated teardown cleanup.

modules.name: Schema Constraint Enforcement
modules.description: Validate that all inputs and outputs adhere strictly to pre-defined structural types with zero schema drift.

modules.name: Dependency Propagation Analysis
modules.description: Trace how a defect or breaking change in a dependency cascades downstream through callers and fixtures.

modules.name: Execution Flakiness Isolation
modules.description: Distinguish genuine functional regressions from non-deterministic timing, layout jitter, and environmental noise.

modules.name: Degraded Graceful Fallback
modules.description: Ensure the system delivers a safe degraded experience or informative user message rather than crashing unhandled.

modules.name: Circuit Breaker Protocol
modules.description: Halt automated retry loops immediately upon 3 consecutive failures to prevent cascading downstream damage.

modules.name: Multi-Trial Self-Healing
modules.description: Execute bounded, reflective retry attempts (K <= 3) with semantic diagnosis before declaring permanent failure.

modules.name: Poison Pill Quarantining
modules.description: Isolate malformed payloads or failing entities into quarantine without halting the overall execution pipeline.

modules.name: State Reconciliation & Rollback
modules.description: Automatically revert partial mutations upon mid-operation failure to preserve database and session clean state.

modules.name: Timeout & Backoff Compensation
modules.description: Configure exponential backoff and dynamic bounded timeouts tailored to specific operation profiles.

modules.name: Blast Radius Containment
modules.description: Confine faults to the single test script or microservice where they occur, preventing cluster-wide domino effects.

modules.name: Truth Anchor Verification
modules.description: Prohibit synthetic passes, swallowed exceptions, and empty assertions; certify outcomes with empirical proof.
